items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: I wasn’t saying oh boy I’m going to be the next Proust

ctx.x: Well yes you know as I say I didn’t know what I was going to do when I got out of college but then by the time I realized I was going to get out of the Army I knew I had to make up my mind and I just sort of said well I guess you’re going to be a writer. That was sort of like it seemed fated. Nothing ever occurred to me that I ought to do anything
else. And I didn’t look forward to it with great glee. I wasn’t saying oh boy I’m going to be the next Proust or something of that kind, because I’d seen too much of it.
You didn’t have any like pie in the sky ideas.
